blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The effects of the shear line, which brought rains to Luzon, will dissipate by Monday (Nov. 23), according to the state weather bureau. However, over the weekend, the shear line will bring up to 100 millimeters of rain to eastern Luzon, said John Manalo, weather specialist at the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration. READ: Shear line, 3 other weather systems to bring rains in parts of PH Manalo said from Friday to Saturday afternoon the weather system will bring 50 to 100 millimeters of rain to the provinces of Cagayan and Isabela.
